title: 分别修复 Chart 包版本与应用版本
answer:
### Chart.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: practice
version: 0.2.0
appVersion: "2026.10"
```

应用版本字符串为2026.10，本次Chart包修订为0.2.0。只修Chart.yaml，确保version为合法SemVer、appVersion保留完整字符串，不把应用版本误当包版本。

## 原理与原题解答
version标识Chart包版本，appVersion描述应用版本，后者通常是信息字段。两者可独立变化，镜像实际使用什么版本由模板和值决定；发布记录必须保存渲染出的镜像摘要。

原题：【Helm 3】Chart.yaml的version与appVersion能否互相替代？

FILES=['Chart.yaml', 'values.yaml', 'templates/info.yaml']
import pathlib,json,yaml,subprocess,tempfile,os,hashlib,copy
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
HELM=os.environ.get("OPSF_HELM_BIN","helm")
def render(values=None,flags=None,release="lab",overrides=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="helm-conversion-") as tmp:
  root=pathlib.Path(tmp)
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")

   (root/name).write_text(text,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  args=list(flags or [])

  ids=[d["metadata"]["name"] for d in docs];assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))
  assert all(set(d)<={"apiVersion","kind","metadata","data"} for d in docs)

 assert len(docs)==1
 return docs[0]

title: 编排环境层、站点层与命令行覆盖顺序
answer:
### arguments.json
```json
["-f", "env.yaml", "-f", "site.yaml", "--set", "replicas=4"]```

编辑arguments.json中的Helm参数数组：先加载env.yaml，再加载site.yaml，最后显式replicas=4。不能修改值文件或模板。最终mode来自站点、timeout继承环境、replicas来自命令行。

## 原理与原题解答
默认值先被外部值覆盖，多个值文件通常后者优先，命令行赋值再参与更高优先合并。最终以渲染和get values为证据；同一key的数组与map合并行为也需注意，不只看文件先后。

原题：【Helm 3】多个-f文件与--set同时出现时如何理解覆盖顺序？

title: 用完整覆盖列表保留既有访问项
answer:
### overrides.yaml
```yaml
allowed:
  - api
  - metrics
  - admin
```

只修改overrides.yaml，使最终allowlist包含api、metrics、admin且顺序如此。Helm列表覆盖不会自动追加，不得依赖修改默认values或重复逗号字符串；label继续继承默认值。

## 原理与原题解答
通常列表作为整体被替换，map按键递归合并。覆盖一个容器列表可能丢掉默认其他元素，应用前检查最终值和资源；不能按JSON patch的逐项修改直觉理解values合并。

原题：【Helm 3】Helm values里的列表会像map一样按元素自动合并吗？

title: 保持数字外观的配置令牌为字符串
answer:
### arguments.json
```json
["--set-string", "token=123"]```

应用令牌必须是字符串123而非数值123。通过arguments.json给Helm传参，禁止修改模板或把值改成0123绕过类型问题；原生渲染同时输出值和输入类型供核验。

## 原理与原题解答
--set-string强制值按字符串解释，--set会按规则推断类型。数字样式ID或布尔样式文本需要明确类型，但最终Kubernetes字段也有类型要求；强制字符串不能修复本来应为整数的字段。

原题：【Helm 3】--set-string与--set主要区别是什么？

title: 把文件正文注入值而不是保存文件路径
answer:
### arguments.json
```json
["--set-file", "bundle=fixtures/bundle.txt"]```

通过arguments.json使用文件正文作为bundle值，路径是fixtures/bundle.txt。正文中的换行和冒号必须完整保留；不能硬编码当前文件内容，验收会替换文件再渲染。

它读取文件内容作为值，适合较长配置文本；普通--set只会传入路径文字。文件内容可能进入release存储与渲染日志，秘密需评估暴露范围，不能因为未出现在命令行就视为安全。

title: 覆盖默认健康动作时删除旧键

### override.yaml

health:

title: 为缺失和空嵌套配置建立默认路径
answer:
### templates/config.yaml
```yaml
{{- $api := .Values.api | default dict -}}
{{- $retry := $api.retry | default dict -}}

kind: ConfigMap
metadata: {name: retry-config, namespace: training}

```

不能，调用方可能缺键、显式置空或使用旧值结构。模板应按契约提供默认、required或安全访问方式，schema负责类型与必填检查；直接链式读取缺失嵌套对象可能导致渲染错误。

title: 把嵌套配置序列化到 YAML 文件块
answer:
### templates/config.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata: {name: serialized, namespace: training}
data:
  settings.yaml: |
{{ toYaml .Values.settings | indent 4 }}
```

修复settings.yaml块的缩进，完整保存settings的嵌套map、list、布尔与数字。ConfigMap.data中的值必须仍为字符串，字符串内容再次解析后等于原始settings；不能只保留一个字段。

title: 建立子 Chart exports 到父值的显式导入
answer:
### Chart.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: practice
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "1.0"
dependencies:
  - name: worker
    version: 0.1.0
    repository: file://charts/worker
    import-values:
      - child: exports.connection
        parent: shared
```

仅修改 Chart.yaml，导入 worker 的 exports.connection 到父 shared。父 ConfigMap 应得到 worker.internal/5432；验收会替换只读子 Chart 导出夹具为 replica.internal/6432，结果应随之变化；显式父 shared.host=override.internal 应优先于导入默认值。

## 原理与原题解答
它把子Chart导出的特定值映射到父值空间，结构变化会影响父模板。把路径当稳定API并在依赖升级时验证，避免与用户显式值形成意外覆盖；仅依赖包可下载不代表值契约兼容。

title: 消除渲染时随机令牌造成的不确定变更
answer:
### templates/config.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: settings
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
data:
  token: {{ required "token must be supplied" .Values.token | quote }}
```

只改模板：本题令牌是公开训练占位符，从 values.token 显式输入，不允许渲染时随机生成或硬编码。相同输入多次渲染必须一致，不同输入必须原样输出，空串/缺键必须清晰拒绝。生产密钥管理与部署存储不在本题验收范围。

## 原理与原题解答
随机函数在渲染时重新求值，升级、diff或GitOps比较可能产生新秘密及持续漂移。应由受控秘密管理流程持久化身份，必要时明确复用规则；不能把随机输出当确定性的期望清单。

FILES=['Chart.yaml', 'values.yaml', 'templates/config.yaml']
import pathlib,json,yaml,subprocess,tempfile,os,hashlib,copy
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
HELM=os.environ.get("OPSF_HELM_BIN","helm")
def render(values=None,flags=None,release="lab",overrides=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="helm-conversion-") as tmp:
  root=pathlib.Path(tmp)
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  if values is not None:(root/"values.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump(values,sort_keys=False),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  for name,text in (overrides or {}).items():
   assert name in FILES
   (root/name).write_text(text,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  args=list(flags or [])
  assert len(args)%2==0 and len(args)<=20
  for key,value in zip(args[::2],args[1::2]):
   assert key in ("-f","--set","--set-string","--set-file"),"unsupported/unbounded Helm CLI flag"
   if key=="-f":assert value in FILES and value.endswith(".yaml")
   elif key=="--set-file":assert "=" in value and value.split("=",1)[1] in FILES
  lint=subprocess.run([HELM,"lint","."],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
  assert lint.returncode==0,lint.stdout+lint.stderr
  proc=subprocess.run([HELM,"template",release,".","--namespace","training",*args],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
  assert proc.returncode==0,proc.stdout+proc.stderr
  docs=[d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(proc.stdout) if d is not None]
  assert all(isinstance(d,dict) and d.get("apiVersion")=="v1" and d.get("kind")=="ConfigMap" and d.get("metadata",{}).get("namespace")=="training" for d in docs),"unexpected resource/API/scope"
  ids=[d["metadata"]["name"] for d in docs];assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))
  assert all(set(d)<={"apiVersion","kind","metadata","data"} for d in docs)
  return docs
def one(docs):
 assert len(docs)==1
 return docs[0]

for file,digest in FIXED.items():

title: 让 fullname 在 Chart 升级时保持资源身份
answer:
### templates/_helpers.tpl
```yaml
{{- define "practice.fullname" -}}{{ .Release.Name }}-{{ .Chart.Name }}{{- end -}}
```

仅改 helper：本题短名称接口明确为 <release>-<chart-name>，Chart 版本不能进入资源名。对 lab/demo release 及 0.1.0/0.2.0/1.0.0 版本矩阵保持预期名称，其他素材和 data.owner 不变。长名称碰撞另有专题，不在本题冒充覆盖。

名称变化可能创建新对象并删除旧对象，状态资源尤其危险。名称接口需稳定且考虑长度截断和碰撞，用户覆盖名称时应评估迁移影响；Chart版本变化不应自动成为所有资源名的一部分。

conversion.original_title: 【Helm 3】资源fullname模板为什么应避免每次升级变化？

title: 把发布版本标签从不可变 selector 中移出
answer:
### templates/config.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  labels:
    chart-version: {{ .Chart.Version | quote }}
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: app}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: app
        chart-version: {{ .Chart.Version | quote }}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: busybox:1.36
          command: ["sleep", "3600"]
```

仅编辑 Deployment 模板：selector 只保留 app=app，Pod 标签仍同时提供 app 与 chart-version，Deployment 普通标签也保留 chart-version 用于观察。三个 Chart 版本离线渲染时 selector 必须相同，普通版本标签随版本变化；镜像、命令、副本数不能变。真实 API 不可变字段更新未在本地执行。

## 原理与原题解答
升级版本会改变不可变选择器或使新旧Pod关系错乱。selector只包含稳定身份标签，版本标签可放普通元数据用于观察；模板渲染通过不表示API允许更改该字段。

title: 按消费者依赖隔离配置摘要，避免无关服务重启
answer:
### templates/config.yaml
```yaml
{{- range $name, $config := .Values.configs }}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ $name }}-config
  namespace: {{ $.Release.Namespace }}
data:
  config.json: {{ $config | toJson | quote }}
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ $name }}
  namespace: {{ $.Release.Namespace }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ index $.Values.replicas $name }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: {{ $name }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: {{ $name }}
      annotations:
        checksum/config: {{ $config | toJson | sha256sum | quote }}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: main
          image: busybox:1.36
          command: ["sleep", "3600"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config
              mountPath: /etc/app
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: {{ $name }}-config
{{- end }}
```

同一 Chart 部署 api 与 worker 两个独立消费者。目前两个 Pod 摘要都涵盖所有配置，导致任意配置变更让全部消费者滚动。编辑模板，建立每个消费者自己的 ConfigMap→只读挂载→Pod 摘要关系：改 api 配置只改变 api 摘要；改 worker 配置只改变 worker 摘要；副本变化不得改变任一摘要。不得串用 ConfigMap、改镜像或添加权限。与单一配置 checksum 基础题不同，本题验收跨消费者变更隔离；不宣称实际运行或滚动成功。

## 原理与原题解答
配置资源变化本身未必触发Deployment滚动更新，把相关内容摘要纳入Pod模板能让变更产生新副本。摘要必须只覆盖所需输入且稳定，不能把时间戳或随机值混入导致无意义重启。

title: 区分资源目标命名空间与跨命名空间观察账号
answer:
### templates/config.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: observer
  namespace: {{ .Values.observerNamespace }}
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: pod-reader
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["pods"]
    verbs: ["get", "list"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: observer-read
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: pod-reader
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: observer
    namespace: {{ .Values.observerNamespace }}
```

本题是跨命名空间引用配置：observer ServiceAccount 位于 values.observerNamespace；Role 和 RoleBinding 位于 Helm release 命名空间；RoleBinding.subjects 必须引用观察账号的真实命名空间，不能盲目统一所有 namespace 字段。仅配置 pods 的 get/list 权限，不得扩大 verbs/resources、创建 ClusterRole 或 Namespace。离线验证两个目标与两个观察命名空间组合；不声称已验证实际 RBAC 授权。

## 原理与原题解答
资源可能被放到硬编码空间，而release元数据仍在操作指定空间，形成权限和审计混乱。除明确跨空间需求外使用一致上下文，渲染时对账所有namespace；-n不会强行覆盖模板每个显式字段。

```

test_files.checks/check.py:
FILES=['Chart.yaml', 'values.yaml', 'templates/config.yaml']
import pathlib,json,yaml,subprocess,tempfile,os,hashlib,copy
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
HELM=os.environ.get("OPSF_HELM_BIN","helm")
def render(values=None,flags=None,release="lab",overrides=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="helm-conversion-") as tmp:
  root=pathlib.Path(tmp)
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  if values is not None:(root/"values.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump(values,sort_keys=False),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  for name,text in (overrides or {}).items():
   assert name in FILES
   (root/name).write_text(text,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  args=list(flags or [])
  assert len(args)%2==0 and len(args)<=20
  for key,value in zip(args[::2],args[1::2]):
   assert key in ("-f","--set","--set-string","--set-file"),"unsupported/unbounded Helm CLI flag"
   if key=="-f":assert value in FILES and value.endswith(".yaml")
   elif key=="--set-file":assert "=" in value and value.split("=",1)[1] in FILES
  lint=subprocess.run([HELM,"lint","."],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
  assert lint.returncode==0,lint.stdout+lint.stderr
  proc=subprocess.run([HELM,"template",release,".","--namespace","training",*args],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
  assert proc.returncode==0,proc.stdout+proc.stderr
  docs=[d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(proc.stdout) if d is not None]
  assert all(isinstance(d,dict) and d.get("apiVersion")=="v1" and d.get("kind")=="ConfigMap" and d.get("metadata",{}).get("namespace")=="training" for d in docs),"unexpected resource/API/scope"
  ids=[d["metadata"]["name"] for d in docs];assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))
  assert all(set(d)<={"apiVersion","kind","metadata","data"} for d in docs)
  return docs
def one(docs):
 assert len(docs)==1
 return docs[0]

answer:
### templates/config.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: public-config
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
data:
  endpoint: {{ .Values.endpoint | quote }}
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: app}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: app}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: busybox:1.36
          command: ["sleep", "3600"]
          env:
            - name: API_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ .Values.existingSecret }}
                  key: password
```

只编辑模板：公共 ConfigMap 只能包含 endpoint；Deployment 的 API_PASSWORD 通过 existingSecret 的 password 键引用。trainingCredential 是公开的泄漏检测标记，不得出现在任何渲染字段；仅改这个标记不应引起资源差异，改 existingSecret 应更新引用。不得新增 Secret、改成直接 env.value、删环境变量或扩大容器权限。验收不查询 Secret 是否存在，不表示运行凭据已就绪。

渲染结果可能含Secret和用户值，debug还会增加上下文，输出进入CI日志后传播面更大。使用脱敏样例或受控产物存储并限制读取，审查选项版本的隐藏秘密能力；不要默认“dry-run不写集群”就没有泄露。

title: 编排具备失败留证的三阶段 Helm hook 审计
answer:
### templates/config.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: audit-input
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
data:
  policy.txt: "allow training"
{{- range $stage := .Values.stages }}
---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: {{ $stage.name }}
  namespace: {{ $.Release.Namespace }}
  annotations:
    helm.sh/hook: post-install,post-upgrade
    helm.sh/hook-weight: {{ $stage.weight | toString | quote }}
    helm.sh/hook-delete-policy: before-hook-creation,hook-succeeded
spec:
  backoffLimit: 0
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 30
  template:
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
        - name: audit
          image: busybox:1.36
          command: ["sh", "-ec", {{ $stage.script | quote }}]
          resources:
            requests: {cpu: 10m, memory: 16Mi}
            limits: {cpu: 100m, memory: 64Mi}
          volumeMounts:
            - {name: fixture, mountPath: /fixtures, readOnly: true}
      volumes:
        - name: fixture
          configMap: {name: audit-input}

### crds/trainingchecks.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: trainingchecks.training.opsforge.invalid
spec:
  group: training.opsforge.invalid
  names:
    kind: TrainingCheck
    plural: trainingchecks
    singular: trainingcheck
  scope: Namespaced
  versions:
  - name: v1
    served: true
    storage: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            required:
            - command
            - timeoutSec
            properties:
              command:
                type: array
                minItems: 1
                items:
                  type: string
              timeoutSec:
                type: integer
                minimum: 1
                maximum: 60
        required:
        - spec
```

仅改 crds/trainingchecks.yaml：该目录不进行 Go 模板替换，因此 API 版本固定为 v1，不能引用 values.crdVersion。补正确的 Namespaced TrainingCheck 结构化 schema：command 为至少一项的字符串数组；timeoutSec 为 1–60 的整数，两者必填。保持 CRD identity/group/names 与给定 CR 模板一致；多个 CR 参数输入不能改变 CRD 本身。原生 Helm --include-crds 离线渲染后核对结构和引用，未运行 API server，不表示 CRD 升级已应用；Helm CRD 生命周期限制保留在原理答案中。

其中CRD不按普通模板渲染，安装时处理，已有CRD通常跳过且升级/删除有特殊限制。CRD结构变化需独立兼容和迁移流程，不能只更新包内文件就认为集群定义已升级。

```json

title: 实现不刷新锁定依赖的离线发布预检
answer:
### preflight.py
```python
import json,os,subprocess,sys
helm=os.environ.get("OPSF_HELM_BIN","helm")
result=subprocess.run([helm,"dependency","build","--skip-refresh"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
ready=result.returncode==0
print(json.dumps({"ready":ready}))
sys.exit(0 if ready else 1)
```

实现 preflight.py：在当前 Chart 目录通过 Helm 的锁定重建流程准备依赖，不允许 update 或刷新来源。锁一致时生成正确归档、打印唯一 JSON {"ready":true} 并退出0；声明与锁不一致时打印 {"ready":false} 并退出1，不能偷偷重算锁继续发布。禁止修改 Chart.yaml、Chart.lock、vendor 等输入。验收三个材料组合（旧版匹配、升级声明与旧锁冲突、新版匹配），还会验证真实归档可渲染，防止仅伪造 ready 输出。所有依赖为 file:// 本地 fixture，不访问集群或远程仓库。

## 原理与原题解答
build依据已有锁文件重建依赖集合，update按声明重新解析并更新锁定结果。正式构建不应无意升级依赖；若无锁文件，行为也需按版本文档核对并在流程中拒绝不确定输入。

原题：【Helm 3】helm dependency build与update为何不应互换使用？

body:
## 环境与初始材料
网页Helm配置练习；平台验收提供Helm3、Python和PyYAML，执行真实离线 dependency build/template，不访问集群。固定素材和可编辑文件如下。

## 操作任务
实现 preflight.py：在当前 Chart 目录通过 Helm 的锁定重建流程准备依赖，不允许 update 或刷新来源。锁一致时生成正确归档、打印唯一 JSON {"ready":true} 并退出0；声明与锁不一致时打印 {"ready":false} 并退出1，不能偷偷重算锁继续发布。禁止修改 Chart.yaml、Chart.lock、vendor 等输入。验收三个材料组合（旧版匹配、升级声明与旧锁冲突、新版匹配），还会验证真实归档可渲染，防止仅伪造 ready 输出。所有依赖为 file:// 本地 fixture，不访问集群或远程仓库。

## 产物
- preflight.py：提交完整修复产物。

仅编辑以上文件，其他Chart/输入样例保持不变；不得新增模板或业务资源。

## 验收方法
运行可信python3 checks/check.py，执行预检程序与真实 Helm，对三种锁状态、输入不变和归档渲染断言。此题只验离线编排，不表示发布、API准入或真实业务已成功。

exercise.environment: 平台提供Helm3/Python/PyYAML的隔离离线验收；无需学员自建集群。
exercise.verification: 执行预检程序，真实锁定依赖重建，检查三种锁状态、退出码、JSON报告、输入不变和依赖渲染；无远程来源。

test_files.checks/check.py:
FILES=['Chart.yaml', 'values.yaml', 'vendor/worker/Chart.yaml', 'vendor/worker/values.yaml', 'vendor/worker/templates/config.yaml', 'Chart.lock', 'preflight.py', 'fixtures/next-chart.json']
import pathlib,json,yaml,subprocess,tempfile,os,hashlib,copy
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
HELM=os.environ.get("OPSF_HELM_BIN","helm")
def render(values=None,flags=None,release="lab",overrides=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="helm-conversion-") as tmp:
  root=pathlib.Path(tmp)
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  if values is not None:(root/"values.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump(values,sort_keys=False),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  for name,text in (overrides or {}).items():
   assert name in FILES
   (root/name).write_text(text,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  args=list(flags or [])
  assert len(args)%2==0 and len(args)<=20
  for key,value in zip(args[::2],args[1::2]):
   assert key in ("-f","--set","--set-string","--set-file"),"unsupported/unbounded Helm CLI flag"
   if key=="-f":assert value in FILES and value.endswith(".yaml")
   elif key=="--set-file":assert "=" in value and value.split("=",1)[1] in FILES
  lint=subprocess.run([HELM,"lint","."],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
  assert lint.returncode==0,lint.stdout+lint.stderr
  proc=subprocess.run([HELM,"template",release,".","--namespace","training",*args],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
  assert proc.returncode==0,proc.stdout+proc.stderr
  docs=[d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(proc.stdout) if d is not None]
  assert all(isinstance(d,dict) and d.get("apiVersion")=="v1" and d.get("kind")=="ConfigMap" and d.get("metadata",{}).get("namespace")=="training" for d in docs),"unexpected resource/API/scope"
  ids=[d["metadata"]["name"] for d in docs];assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))
  assert all(set(d)<={"apiVersion","kind","metadata","data"} for d in docs)
  return docs
def one(docs):
 assert len(docs)==1
 return docs[0]

FIXED={'Chart.yaml': '7494129e33e8898c8bad3fcbb30922a5a23e3e7acfeca3f764efa39a92d0cb0b', 'values.yaml': 'ca3d163bab055381827226140568f3bef7eaac187cebd76878e0b63e9e442356', 'vendor/worker/Chart.yaml': '2a600b4c39fd01ccbcb36ba8e163f9aa4b7a66ca32a3f237362780dae7aa64e7', 'vendor/worker/values.yaml': 'ca3d163bab055381827226140568f3bef7eaac187cebd76878e0b63e9e442356', 'vendor/worker/templates/config.yaml': '8df7f576ed9eb1a988d888d7a31c0986e29c201e11411fc7eb4bbc18b2b24247', 'Chart.lock': '2035cdb98c605c8278324c05e1e3b837120e280db9eade0afdfaddc83a7363c6', 'fixtures/next-chart.json': '04a7ca92c6e02a0b393ebfe19738411121be9a473bdeb128e57ac49a5a1badef'}
for file,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(file).read_text(encoding="utf8").encode("utf8")).hexdigest()==digest,"fixed teaching material modified"
assert {p.as_posix() for p in pathlib.Path("templates").rglob("*") if p.is_file()}=={x for x in FILES if x.startswith("templates/")},"extra template injection"

import sys
base={name:(BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8") for name in FILES if not name.startswith("fixtures/") and name!="preflight.py"}
next_files=json.loads(pathlib.Path("fixtures/next-chart.json").read_text())
stale={**next_files,"Chart.lock":base["Chart.lock"]}
for material,ready,version in [(base,True,"0.1.0"),(stale,False,"0.2.0"),(next_files,True,"0.2.0")]:
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="preflight-contract-") as tmp:
  root=pathlib.Path(tmp)
  for name,text in material.items():
   p=root/name;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text(text,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  (root/"preflight.py").write_text(pathlib.Path("preflight.py").read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  before={n:hashlib.sha256((root/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in material}
  env=dict(os.environ,OPSF_HELM_BIN=HELM,HELM_REPOSITORY_CONFIG=str(root/"repo.yaml"),HELM_REPOSITORY_CACHE=str(root/"cache"))
  result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"preflight.py"],cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
  assert result.returncode==(0 if ready else 1),result.stdout+result.stderr
  report=json.loads(result.stdout);assert report=={"ready":ready} and type(report["ready"]) is bool
  assert before=={n:hashlib.sha256((root/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in material},"preflight changed reviewed inputs"
  archives=list((root/"charts").glob("*.tgz"))
  if not ready:assert not archives;continue
  assert [p.name for p in archives]==["worker-"+version+".tgz"]
  rendered=subprocess.run([HELM,"template","lab",".","--namespace","training"],cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
  assert rendered.returncode==0,rendered.stderr
  docs=[d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(rendered.stdout) if d is not None]
  assert docs==[{"apiVersion":"v1","kind":"ConfigMap","metadata":{"name":"worker","namespace":"training"},"data":{"chartVersion":version}}]

print("Native Helm conversion contract complete; no cluster API called")

assessment.validation_scope: Native offline Helm behavior; not Kubernetes installation/runtime

title: 限制 Helm 指定修订的只读审计权限
answer:
### templates/role.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: history-reader
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
  resourceNames:
{{ range .Values.revisions }}
  - {{ printf "sh.helm.release.v1.%s.v%d" $.Values.release (int .) | quote }}
{{ end }}
```

已有受控审计器只使用已知 Secret 名称逐个 get。修复 Role，使它仅能 get 输入 release 的指定修订 Secret；不得 list/watch、读取其他 Secret 或写入。release 和 revisions 为可信审计清单，至少覆盖 billing:[2,5] 与 worker:[1,9,12]。这里只生成授权片段，不创建账号/绑定，不宣称 helm list/history 命令可用。

## 原理与原题解答
release通常存于目标namespace的Secret，包含清单和值等敏感信息。能读它的身份可能获取发布秘密和历史配置，权限设计需按内容评估；不要把所有Secret读权限作为普通状态查看的默认条件。

原题：【Helm 3】Helm 3默认release存储为什么需要考虑Secret读权限？

title: 声明数据卷保留范围并交付卸载后的资产处理契约
answer:
### templates/storage.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-data
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  annotations:
    helm.sh/resource-policy: keep
spec:
  accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
  storageClassName: {{ .Values.storageClass | quote }}
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: {{ .Values.size | quote }}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-runtime
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
data:
  mode: active
```

### retention-plan.json
```json
{
  "retained": [
    {
      "kind": "PersistentVolumeClaim",
      "nameSuffix": "-data",
      "reason": "application-data",
      "afterUninstall": "inventory-and-preserve",
      "reinstall": "inspect-existing-ownership-before-adoption"
    }
  ],
  "automaticDelete": false
}
```

发布合同规定仅数据 PVC 保留，运行时 ConfigMap 随 release 生命周期管理。修复清单，并提交机器可读保留计划：retained 数组准确记录 kind=PersistentVolumeClaim、nameSuffix=-data、reason=application-data、afterUninstall=inventory-and-preserve、reinstall=inspect-existing-ownership-before-adoption，automaticDelete=false。计划是后续人工资产管理的交付契约，不会自动执行。所有权冲突不得通过自动删卷解决；keep 也不能当作备份或可自动收养的保证。覆盖不同 release/存储类/容量，验收不真实卸载资源。

## 原理与原题解答
它可让指定资源在某些删除操作中保留，但资源可能变成Helm不再正常管理的遗留对象。必须记录所有权、数据保留与重新接管方式，避免同名安装冲突；keep不是备份。

原题：【Helm 3】helm.sh/resource-policy: keep为何需要有后续管理计划？

answer:
### release_diff.py
```python
import sys,os,json,subprocess,yaml
def identities(path,namespace):
 result=subprocess.run([os.environ.get("OPSF_HELM_BIN","helm"),"template","audit",path,"--namespace",namespace],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
 return {tuple(str(x) for x in (d["apiVersion"],d["kind"],d.get("metadata",{}).get("namespace",namespace),d["metadata"]["name"])) for d in yaml.safe_load_all(result.stdout) if d}
def records(items):
 return [dict(zip(("apiVersion","kind","namespace","name"),key)) for key in sorted(items)]
a=identities(sys.argv[1],sys.argv[3]);b=identities(sys.argv[2],sys.argv[3])
print(json.dumps({"removed":records(a-b),"added":records(b-a),"retained":records(a&b)},sort_keys=True))
```

实现 release_diff.py OLD_CHART NEW_CHART NAMESPACE，调用本地 helm template 渲染两个版本，标准输出唯一 JSON 对象，字段 removed/added/retained 均为数组，元素包含 apiVersion/kind/namespace/name。身份必须包含类型与命名空间，不能只按名字；data 内容变化不等于删除重建。不要修改输入素材或调用集群。初始样例有同名 ConfigMap 与 Service，新版删除 Service 并新增 ConfigMap；同时验证反向比较、同版本比较和两个命名空间。该报告用于审核可能删除的对象，不能替代读取线上 release 历史或实际升级预演。

title: 验证离线 Chart 交付包的摘要、元数据和文件闭包
answer:
### verify_bundle.py
```python
import pathlib,sys,json,hashlib,subprocess,os,re,yaml
def main():
 manifest=json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf8"))
 root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
 assert set(manifest)=={"artifacts"} and isinstance(manifest["artifacts"],list) and manifest["artifacts"]
 records=manifest["artifacts"];names=[]
 for record in records:
  assert set(record)=={"file","name","version","appVersion","sha256"}
  name=record["file"]
  assert isinstance(name,str) and re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*[.]tgz",name)
  assert name not in names
  names.append(name)
 assert {p.name for p in root.iterdir()}==set(names)
 for record in records:
  path=root/record["file"]
  assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink()
  assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}",record["sha256"])
  assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==record["sha256"]
  output=subprocess.run([os.environ.get("OPSF_HELM_BIN","helm"),"show","chart",str(path)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
  chart=yaml.safe_load(output.stdout)
  assert all(str(chart[key])==record[key] for key in ("name","version","appVersion"))
 print(json.dumps({"approved":sorted(names)}))
if __name__=="__main__":
 try:main()
 except Exception:
  print(json.dumps({"error":"bundle verification failed"}));sys.exit(1)
```

实现 verify_bundle.py MANIFEST BUNDLE_DIR：只接受清单声明的完整文件集合，禁止多包、缺包、重复记录、目录或路径穿越；每个文件校验SHA256，随后用 helm show chart 验证 name/version/appVersion 与受审清单相同。成功标准输出唯一 {"approved":[文件名排序]} 并退出0；任意失败输出error并非0退出，不能部分放行。可信验收会将随题的Base64包解码成真实tgz输入，不需要另外部署仓库。检查合法包、字节篡改、元数据谎报、缺包、多包、重复和路径越界。清单作为受信审阅输入，本题不实现签名根或真实OCI认证，也不证明包里的应用安全可运行。

## 原理与原题解答
将Chart、依赖、镜像和必要证明组成不可变清单，按摘要复制到离线可信仓库，校验签名身份。离线渲染记录实际工具版本并禁止未声明外联，验收替换依赖包和缺镜像时失败关闭。

title: 补全可直接渲染的默认 values 契约
answer:
### values.yaml
```yaml
http:
  listen: 8080
  path: /ready
logging:
  level: info
  json: false
retry:
  attempts: 0
labels:
  team: platform
```

只补 values.yaml，提供可直接渲染的默认结构：http.listen=8080、http.path=/ready、logging.level=info、logging.json=false（布尔）、retry.attempts=0（整数）、labels.team=platform。每个模板实际读取的路径都要有默认值；不放密码或未知键。默认渲染无需额外 -f。再验证部署时覆盖 listen=9090 与 level=debug 后其余默认仍保留。固定模板不能修改。

## 原理与原题解答
它应提供清晰默认结构和必要注释，但必填秘密等可要求调用方明确提供。默认必须安全且与schema一致，不能把演示凭据当生产默认，也不能认为注释会被运行时强制校验。

title: 交付原生 Helm post-renderer 并保持资源选择器不变
answer:
### post_render.py
```python
import sys,yaml
team=sys.argv[1]
documents=[x for x in yaml.safe_load_all(sys.stdin.read()) if x is not None]
for obj in documents:
 obj.setdefault("metadata",{}).setdefault("labels",{})["team.example.com/owner"]=team
 kind=obj.get("kind")
 if kind in ("Deployment","StatefulSet","DaemonSet","Job"):
  pod=obj["spec"]["template"]
 elif kind=="CronJob":
  pod=obj["spec"]["jobTemplate"]["spec"]["template"]
 else:
  pod=None
 if pod is not None:
  pod.setdefault("metadata",{}).setdefault("labels",{})["team.example.com/owner"]=team
sys.stdout.write(yaml.safe_dump_all(documents,sort_keys=False))
```

它在模板后改写最终清单，可改变镜像、权限和资源，即使Chart和值相同。固定其程序版本与参数、记录输出摘要并审查差异；它是可执行逻辑，不可用来绕过禁止代码修改规则。

title: 交付 Kubernetes 版本与可选 API 的交叉渲染矩阵
answer:
### Chart.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: practice
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "1.0"
kubeVersion: ">=1.26.0-0 <1.32.0-0"
```

### templates/optional.yaml
```yaml
{{ if .Values.monitoring }}
{{ if not (.Capabilities.APIVersions.Has "monitoring.coreos.com/v1") }}{{ fail "ServiceMonitor API required by monitoring feature" }}{{ end }}
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: ServiceMonitor
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: {{ .Release.Name | quote }}}
  namespaceSelector:
    matchNames: [{{ .Release.Namespace | quote }}]
  endpoints:
  - port: metrics
    interval: "30s"
---
{{ end }}
{{ if .Values.disruptionBudget }}
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
spec:
  minAvailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: {{ .Release.Name | quote }}}
{{ end }}
```

FILES=['Chart.yaml', 'values.yaml', 'configs/app.conf', 'configs/agent.conf', 'templates/config.yaml']
import pathlib,json,yaml,subprocess,tempfile,os,hashlib,copy
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
HELM=os.environ.get("OPSF_HELM_BIN","helm")
def render(values=None,flags=None,release="lab",overrides=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="helm-conversion-") as tmp:
  root=pathlib.Path(tmp)
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  if values is not None:(root/"values.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump(values,sort_keys=False),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  for name,text in (overrides or {}).items():
   assert name in FILES
   (root/name).write_text(text,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  args=list(flags or [])
  assert len(args)%2==0 and len(args)<=20
  for key,value in zip(args[::2],args[1::2]):
   assert key in ("-f","--set","--set-string","--set-file"),"unsupported/unbounded Helm CLI flag"
   if key=="-f":assert value in FILES and value.endswith(".yaml")
   elif key=="--set-file":assert "=" in value and value.split("=",1)[1] in FILES
  lint=subprocess.run([HELM,"lint","."],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=15)
  assert lint.returncode==0,lint.stdout+lint.stderr
  proc=subprocess.run([HELM,"template",release,".","--namespace","training",*args],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=15)
  assert proc.returncode==0,proc.stdout+proc.stderr
  docs=[d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(proc.stdout) if d is not None]
  assert all(isinstance(d,dict) and d.get("apiVersion")=="v1" and d.get("kind")=="ConfigMap" and d.get("metadata",{}).get("namespace")=="training" for d in docs),"unexpected resource/API/scope"
  ids=[d["metadata"]["name"] for d in docs];assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))
  assert all(set(d)<={"apiVersion","kind","metadata","data"} for d in docs)
  return docs
def one(docs):
 assert len(docs)==1
 return docs[0]

for file,digest in FIXED.items():

assert {p.as_posix() for p in pathlib.Path("templates").rglob("*") if p.is_file()}=={x for x in FILES if x.startswith("templates/")},"extra template injection"

for a,b,okay in cases:
 overrides={"configs/app.conf":a,"configs/agent.conf":b}
 try:docs=render(overrides=overrides)
 except AssertionError:

title: 拆分共享 CRD 与租户 Chart 的资源所有权
answer:
### foundation/templates/shared.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: widgets.training.opsforge.example
spec:
  group: training.opsforge.example
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    plural: widgets
    singular: widget
    kind: Widget
  versions:
  - name: v1
    served: true
    storage: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        required: [spec]
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            required: [image, replicas]
            properties:
              image: {type: string}
              replicas: {type: integer, minimum: 0, maximum: 5}
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: shared-widget-reader
rules:
- apiGroups: ["training.opsforge.example"]
  resources: ["widgets"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
```

### application/templates/runtime.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: training.opsforge.example/v1
kind: Widget
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
spec:
  image: {{ .Values.image | quote }}
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicas }}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-reader
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
automountServiceAccountToken: false
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-reader
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-reader
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: shared-widget-reader
```

把集群级Widget CRD和shared-widget-reader ClusterRole从租户application Chart抽到单一foundation Chart。foundation只产生这两个集群资源，不能带namespace；application对每个release/namespace只产生一个Widget、一个默认不自动挂令牌的ServiceAccount和引用共享ClusterRole的RoleBinding。保留给定CRD字段/范围、只读权限和Widget参数。不同租户不能重复创建CRD/ClusterRole，也不能绑到其他租户账号。这里验证包所有权分工及静态引用；真实安装需平台先提供CRD/控制器，再验证API准入、控制器行为和权限。本题不执行共享资源升级/卸载。

## 原理与原题解答
把共享集群资源交给独立平台生命周期管理，应用release只引用并声明版本要求。避免各release都声称拥有同一对象，卸载应用不应删除其他使用者依赖；验收至少覆盖两个应用的独立升级与卸载。

body:
## 环境与初始材料
网页Helm配置练习；平台验收提供Helm3、Python和PyYAML，执行真实离线lint/template，不访问集群。固定素材和可编辑文件如下。

## 操作任务
把集群级Widget CRD和shared-widget-reader ClusterRole从租户application Chart抽到单一foundation Chart。foundation只产生这两个集群资源，不能带namespace；application对每个release/namespace只产生一个Widget、一个默认不自动挂令牌的ServiceAccount和引用共享ClusterRole的RoleBinding。保留给定CRD字段/范围、只读权限和Widget参数。不同租户不能重复创建CRD/ClusterRole，也不能绑到其他租户账号。这里验证包所有权分工及静态引用；真实安装需平台先提供CRD/控制器，再验证API准入、控制器行为和权限。本题不执行共享资源升级/卸载。

## 产物
- foundation/templates/shared.yaml：提交完整修复产物。
- application/templates/runtime.yaml：提交完整修复产物。

仅编辑以上文件，其他Chart/输入样例保持不变；不得新增模板或业务资源。

## 验收方法
运行可信python3 checks/check.py，实际调用Helm并解析渲染资源，通过多输入、类型、来源/作用域约束验证。此题只验离线编排，不表示发布、API准入或真实业务已成功。

exercise.environment: 平台提供Helm3/Python/PyYAML的隔离离线验收；无需学员自建集群。
exercise.verification: 实际helm lint/template，多组值和边界语义检查；无真实集群执行。

test_files.checks/check.py:
FILES=['foundation/Chart.yaml', 'foundation/values.yaml', 'foundation/templates/shared.yaml', 'application/Chart.yaml', 'application/values.yaml', 'application/templates/runtime.yaml']
import pathlib,json,yaml,subprocess,tempfile,os,hashlib,copy
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
HELM=os.environ.get("OPSF_HELM_BIN","helm")
def render(values=None,flags=None,release="lab",overrides=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="helm-conversion-") as tmp:
  root=pathlib.Path(tmp)
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  if values is not None:(root/"values.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump(values,sort_keys=False),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  for name,text in (overrides or {}).items():
   assert name in FILES
   (root/name).write_text(text,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  args=list(flags or [])
  assert len(args)%2==0 and len(args)<=20
  for key,value in zip(args[::2],args[1::2]):
   assert key in ("-f","--set","--set-string","--set-file"),"unsupported/unbounded Helm CLI flag"
   if key=="-f":assert value in FILES and value.endswith(".yaml")
   elif key=="--set-file":assert "=" in value and value.split("=",1)[1] in FILES
  lint=subprocess.run([HELM,"lint","."],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=15)
  assert lint.returncode==0,lint.stdout+lint.stderr
  proc=subprocess.run([HELM,"template",release,".","--namespace","training",*args],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=15)
  assert proc.returncode==0,proc.stdout+proc.stderr
  docs=[d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(proc.stdout) if d is not None]
  assert all(isinstance(d,dict) and d.get("apiVersion")=="v1" and d.get("kind")=="ConfigMap" and d.get("metadata",{}).get("namespace")=="training" for d in docs),"unexpected resource/API/scope"
  ids=[d["metadata"]["name"] for d in docs];assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))
  assert all(set(d)<={"apiVersion","kind","metadata","data"} for d in docs)
  return docs
def one(docs):
 assert len(docs)==1
 return docs[0]

FIXED={'foundation/Chart.yaml': 'c755c332612d9af7f621237009326fa415f3f8a05f33e798337ece3f5db63415', 'foundation/values.yaml': 'ca3d163bab055381827226140568f3bef7eaac187cebd76878e0b63e9e442356', 'application/Chart.yaml': 'c13cb91a7b66753451c874b1f5d0203df326c7b038d89bef9c19453577042492', 'application/values.yaml': '97acd55ec57b5140c01221516b6bfc20730f0dbe5048435c861dfdc199cfd00e'}
for file,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(file).read_text(encoding="utf8").encode("utf8")).hexdigest()==digest,"fixed teaching material modified"
assert {p.as_posix() for p in pathlib.Path("templates").rglob("*") if p.is_file()}=={x for x in FILES if x.startswith("templates/")},"extra template injection"

for chart in ("foundation","application"):
 assert {p.as_posix() for p in pathlib.Path(chart+"/templates").rglob("*") if p.is_file()}=={n for n in FILES if n.startswith(chart+"/templates/")}
def render_part(chart,release,namespace,flags=None):
 lint=subprocess.run([HELM,"lint",chart],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=15);assert lint.returncode==0,lint.stderr+lint.stdout
 proc=subprocess.run([HELM,"template",release,chart,"--namespace",namespace,*(flags or [])],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=15)
 assert proc.returncode==0,proc.stderr
 return [x for x in yaml.safe_load_all(proc.stdout) if x is not None]
expected_global=[{'apiVersion': 'apiextensions.k8s.io/v1', 'kind': 'CustomResourceDefinition', 'metadata': {'name': 'widgets.training.opsforge.example'}, 'spec': {'group': 'training.opsforge.example', 'scope': 'Namespaced', 'names': {'plural': 'widgets', 'singular': 'widget', 'kind': 'Widget'}, 'versions': [{'name': 'v1', 'served': True, 'storage': True, 'schema': {'openAPIV3Schema': {'type': 'object', 'required': ['spec'], 'properties': {'spec': {'type': 'object', 'required': ['image', 'replicas'], 'properties': {'image': {'type': 'string'}, 'replicas': {'type': 'integer', 'minimum': 0, 'maximum': 5}}}}}}}]}}, {'apiVersion': 'rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1', 'kind': 'ClusterRole', 'metadata': {'name': 'shared-widget-reader'}, 'rules': [{'apiGroups': ['training.opsforge.example'], 'resources': ['widgets'], 'verbs': ['get', 'list', 'watch']}]}]
for namespace in ("platform-a","platform-b"):
 docs=render_part("foundation","shared",namespace)
 assert sorted(json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True) for x in docs)==sorted(json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True) for x in expected_global),"shared resources must have a single cluster-scoped owner"
for release,ns,count in (("alpha","tenant-a",0),("beta","tenant-b",5),("gamma","tenant-a",2)):
 image="registry.invalid/"+release+":2";docs=render_part("application",release,ns,["--set","replicas="+str(count),"--set-string","image="+image])
 name=release+"-reader"
 expected=[
 {"apiVersion":"training.opsforge.example/v1","kind":"Widget","metadata":{"name":release,"namespace":ns},"spec":{"image":image,"replicas":count}},
 {"apiVersion":"v1","kind":"ServiceAccount","metadata":{"name":name,"namespace":ns},"automountServiceAccountToken":False},
 {"apiVersion":"rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1","kind":"RoleBinding","metadata":{"name":name,"namespace":ns},"subjects":[{"kind":"ServiceAccount","name":name,"namespace":ns}],"roleRef":{"apiGroup":"rbac.authorization.k8s.io","kind":"ClusterRole","name":"shared-widget-reader"}}]
 assert sorted(json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True) for x in docs)==sorted(json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True) for x in expected),"tenant resource/identity/ownership violation"

print("Native Helm conversion contract complete; no cluster API called")

title: 执行真实 Helm 验签并独立审查有限工作负载策略
answer:
### verify_release.py
```python
import sys,os,json,subprocess,yaml
def main():
 package,keyring=sys.argv[1:3];helm=os.environ.get("OPSF_HELM_BIN","helm")
 verified=subprocess.run([helm,"verify",package,"--keyring",keyring],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8")
 assert verified.returncode==0
 rendered=subprocess.run([helm,"template","audit",package,"--namespace","training"],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",check=True)
 docs=[x for x in yaml.safe_load_all(rendered.stdout) if x]
 assert docs
 for obj in docs:
  assert obj.get("apiVersion")=="apps/v1" and obj.get("kind")=="Deployment"
  pod=obj["spec"]["template"]["spec"]
  assert all(pod.get(k,False) is False for k in ("hostNetwork","hostPID","hostIPC"))
  assert all("hostPath" not in v for v in pod.get("volumes",[]))
  assert isinstance(pod.get("containers"),list) and pod["containers"]
  containers=pod.get("containers",[])+pod.get("initContainers",[])
  assert containers
  for c in containers:
   ctx=c.get("securityContext",{})
   assert ctx.get("privileged",False) is False
   assert ctx.get("runAsNonRoot") is True and ctx.get("allowPrivilegeEscalation") is False
   assert "ALL" in ctx.get("capabilities",{}).get("drop",[])
   assert not ctx.get("capabilities",{}).get("add",[])
 print(json.dumps({"verified":True,"policyPassed":True}))
if __name__=="__main__":
 try:main()
 except Exception:
  print(json.dumps({"verified":False,"policyPassed":False}));sys.exit(1)
```

实现 verify_release.py PACKAGE PUBLIC_KEYRING。先实际调用helm verify验证与包同名.prov及受信公钥；再实际helm template解析清单，只接受apps/v1 Deployment，要求至少一个容器；禁止hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC、hostPath、privileged、增加capabilities；所有普通及init容器必须runAsNonRoot=true、allowPrivilegeEscalation=false并drop ALL。只有验签和这些限定策略都通过才输出{"verified":true,"policyPassed":true}退出0，否则非0退出。随题有同名、同版本、同一合成公钥签名的合规与特权包，公钥与包在验收时从Base64解码。仅公钥保留，不需要GPG或私钥。该有限策略不代表完整生产安全、镜像可信或业务正确，参考原理需说明签名和适用性是独立检查。

## 原理与原题解答
它验证包内容与签名身份的关系，还需建立签名密钥信任和检查配置、权限及运行行为。恶意或错误模板也可能被签名，不能跳过审查；记录实际验证身份和包摘要。

solution_files.verify_release.py:
import sys,os,json,subprocess,yaml
def main():
 package,keyring=sys.argv[1:3];helm=os.environ.get("OPSF_HELM_BIN","helm")
 verified=subprocess.run([helm,"verify",package,"--keyring",keyring],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8")
 assert verified.returncode==0
 rendered=subprocess.run([helm,"template","audit",package,"--namespace","training"],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",check=True)
 docs=[x for x in yaml.safe_load_all(rendered.stdout) if x]
 assert docs
 for obj in docs:
  assert obj.get("apiVersion")=="apps/v1" and obj.get("kind")=="Deployment"
  pod=obj["spec"]["template"]["spec"]
  assert all(pod.get(k,False) is False for k in ("hostNetwork","hostPID","hostIPC"))
  assert all("hostPath" not in v for v in pod.get("volumes",[]))
  assert isinstance(pod.get("containers"),list) and pod["containers"]
  containers=pod.get("containers",[])+pod.get("initContainers",[])
  assert containers
  for c in containers:
   ctx=c.get("securityContext",{})
   assert ctx.get("privileged",False) is False
   assert ctx.get("runAsNonRoot") is True and ctx.get("allowPrivilegeEscalation") is False
   assert "ALL" in ctx.get("capabilities",{}).get("drop",[])
   assert not ctx.get("capabilities",{}).get("add",[])
 print(json.dumps({"verified":True,"policyPassed":True}))
if __name__=="__main__":
 try:main()
 except Exception:
  print(json.dumps({"verified":False,"policyPassed":False}));sys.exit(1)

body:
## 环境与初始材料
网页Helm配置练习；平台验收提供Helm3、Python和PyYAML，执行真实离线verify/template，不访问集群。固定素材和可编辑文件如下。

## 操作任务
实现 verify_release.py PACKAGE PUBLIC_KEYRING。先实际调用helm verify验证与包同名.prov及受信公钥；再实际helm template解析清单，只接受apps/v1 Deployment，要求至少一个普通容器；禁止hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC、hostPath、privileged、增加capabilities；所有普通及init容器必须runAsNonRoot=true、allowPrivilegeEscalation=false并drop ALL。只有验签和这些限定策略都通过才输出{"verified":true,"policyPassed":true}退出0，否则非0退出。随题有同名、同版本、同一合成公钥签名的合规包与多个逐项违反策略的包，公钥与包在验收时从Base64解码。仅公钥保留，不需要GPG或私钥。该有限策略不代表完整生产安全、镜像可信或业务正确，参考原理需说明签名和适用性是独立检查。

## 产物
- verify_release.py：提交完整修复产物。

仅编辑以上文件，其他Chart/输入样例保持不变；不得新增模板或业务资源。

## 验收方法
运行可信python3 checks/check.py，实际调用Helm并解析渲染资源，通过多输入、类型、来源/作用域约束验证。此题只验离线编排，不表示发布、API准入或真实业务已成功。

  content=base64.b64decode(pathlib.Path("fixtures/"+label+".tgz.b64").read_text())

answer:
### probe.py
```python
import sys,json,urllib.request
def fetch(url):
 with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=2) as response:
  assert response.status==200
  raw=response.read(65537);assert len(raw)<=65536
  return json.loads(raw)
try:
 base=sys.argv[1].rstrip("/");expected=sys.argv[2]
 assert fetch(base+"/healthz")=={"status":"ok"}
 assert fetch(base+"/api/version").get("version")==expected
 print(json.dumps({"healthy":True,"version":expected}))
except Exception:
 print(json.dumps({"healthy":False}));sys.exit(1)
```

### templates/smoke.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-probe
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
data:
  probe.py: |
{{ .Files.Get "probe.py" | indent 4 }}
---
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-smoke
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  annotations:
    helm.sh/hook: test
    helm.sh/hook-delete-policy: before-hook-creation,hook-succeeded
spec:
  backoffLimit: 0
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 30
  template:
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
      - name: probe
        image: python:3.12-slim
        command: ["python3", "/probe/probe.py", {{ printf "http://%s:8080" .Release.Name | quote }}, {{ .Values.expectedVersion | quote }}]
        resources:
          requests: {cpu: 10m, memory: 32Mi}
          limits: {cpu: 100m, memory: 64Mi}
        volumeMounts: [{name: probe, mountPath: /probe, readOnly: true}]
      volumes:
      - name: probe
        configMap:
          name: {{ .Release.Name }}-probe
```

for mode in ("ok","health-error","health-body","version-error","wrong-version","malformed","large","timeout"):
 paths=[]
 class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
  def log_message(self,*args):pass
  def do_GET(self):
   paths.append(self.path);status=200
   if mode=="timeout":time.sleep(2.5)
   payload={"status":"ok"} if self.path=="/healthz" else {"version":"7.8.9"}
   if mode=="health-error" and self.path=="/healthz":status=503
   if mode=="health-body" and self.path=="/healthz":payload={"status":"starting"}

## 环境与初始材料
网页Helm配置练习；平台验收提供Helm3、Python和PyYAML，执行真实离线lint/template，不访问集群。固定素材和可编辑文件如下。

## 操作任务
完成两个模板：资源名均release-web，声明当前namespace；Deployment镜像/副本/容器端口取values，容器命名端口http；Service是ClusterIP，servicePort取values而targetPort引用http。Deployment selector、Pod labels与Service selector用instance=release和component=web对应；readinessProbe通过http命名端口访问/ready，initialDelaySeconds2、periodSeconds5。实际端口与服务端口可以不同，不能把servicePort当containerPort。Chart与values不改；只提交离线清单，不在业务集群安装或切换默认身份。HTTP应用运行与实际就绪属于额外隔离运行验收，本题不宣称通过。

## 产物
- templates/deployment.yaml：提交完整修复产物。
- templates/service.yaml：提交完整修复产物。

仅编辑以上文件，其他Chart/输入样例保持不变；不得新增模板或业务资源。

运行可信python3 checks/check.py，实际调用Helm并解析渲染资源，通过多输入、类型、来源/作用域约束验证。此题只验离线编排，不表示发布、API准入或真实业务已成功。

### templates/deployment.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-web
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicas }}
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name | quote }}, app.kubernetes.io/component: web}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name | quote }}, app.kubernetes.io/component: web}
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: {{ .Values.image | quote }}
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: {{ .Values.port }}
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /ready
            port: http
          initialDelaySeconds: 2
          periodSeconds: 5
```

### templates/service.yaml
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-web
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector: {app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name | quote }}, app.kubernetes.io/component: web}
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: {{ .Values.servicePort }}
    targetPort: http
```

完成两个模板：资源名均release-web，声明当前namespace；Deployment镜像/副本/容器端口取values，容器命名端口http；Service是ClusterIP，servicePort取values而targetPort引用http。Deployment selector、Pod labels与Service selector用instance=release和component=web对应；readinessProbe通过http命名端口访问/ready，initialDelaySeconds2、periodSeconds5。实际端口与服务端口可以不同，不能把servicePort当containerPort。Chart与values不改；只提交离线清单，不在业务集群安装或切换默认身份。HTTP应用运行与实际就绪属于额外隔离运行验收，本题不宣称通过。

## 原理与原题解答
Chart.yaml 定义名称与版本；values.yaml 放 image、replicas、port；Deployment 模板引用 .Values 并使用匹配标签，增加 readinessProbe。先 helm lint chart，再 helm template demo chart 检查渲染结果；安装后查实际 Pod。普通工作区使用 HELM_DRIVER=configmap。

FILES=['Chart.yaml', 'values.yaml', 'templates/deployment.yaml', 'templates/service.yaml']
import pathlib,json,yaml,subprocess,tempfile,os,hashlib,copy
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
HELM=os.environ.get("OPSF_HELM_BIN","helm")
def render(values=None,flags=None,release="lab",overrides=None):
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="helm-conversion-") as tmp:
  root=pathlib.Path(tmp)
  for name in FILES:
   dest=root/name;dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dest.write_text((BASE/name).read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  if values is not None:(root/"values.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump(values,sort_keys=False),encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  for name,text in (overrides or {}).items():
   assert name in FILES
   (root/name).write_text(text,encoding="utf8",newline="\n")
  args=list(flags or [])
  assert len(args)%2==0 and len(args)<=20
  for key,value in zip(args[::2],args[1::2]):
   assert key in ("-f","--set","--set-string","--set-file"),"unsupported/unbounded Helm CLI flag"
   if key=="-f":assert value in FILES and value.endswith(".yaml")
   elif key=="--set-file":assert "=" in value and value.split("=",1)[1] in FILES
  lint=subprocess.run([HELM,"lint","."],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=15)
  assert lint.returncode==0,lint.stdout+lint.stderr
  proc=subprocess.run([HELM,"template",release,".","--namespace","training",*args],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf8",timeout=15)
  assert proc.returncode==0,proc.stdout+proc.stderr
  docs=[d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(proc.stdout) if d is not None]
  assert all(isinstance(d,dict) and ((d.get("apiVersion"),d.get("kind")) in (("apps/v1","Deployment"),("v1","Service"))) and d.get("metadata",{}).get("namespace")=="training" for d in docs),"unexpected resource/API/scope"
  ids=[(d["kind"],d["metadata"]["name"]) for d in docs];assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))
  assert all(set(d)<={"apiVersion","kind","metadata","spec"} for d in docs)
  return docs
def one(docs):
 assert len(docs)==1
 return docs[0]

body:
## 环境与初始材料
网页Helm配置练习；平台验收提供Helm3、Python和PyYAML，执行真实离线lint/template，不访问集群。固定素材和可编辑文件如下。

## 操作任务
backend三个键都必填：host非空字符串、retryCount为0..5整数（0=不重试）、tls为布尔。拒绝其他键、类型和缺字段；schema负责结构/类型，模板空值检查只适用于host，不能把合法的0/false当缺失。输出唯一ConfigMap的host/retries/tls字符串，不做网络请求，也不强制真实外部TLS连接。修复schema和模板，验证缺字段与合法空值区别；语义等价实现可以不拘泥某个模板函数写法。

## 产物
- values.schema.json：提交完整修复产物。
- templates/config.yaml：提交完整修复产物。

仅编辑以上文件，其他Chart/输入样例保持不变；不得新增模板或业务资源。

## 验收方法
运行可信python3 checks/check.py，实际调用Helm并解析渲染资源，通过多输入、类型、来源/作用域约束验证。此题只验离线编排，不表示发布、API准入或真实业务已成功。
